about: E106: every refusal code a later, expensive stage can raise (test_refusal_parity.LATER), with its class: A predicted early by the same function or constant (`early`: path::needle), B a rework hole (`early`: the cheap check that would catch it, `open`: why it is still open), C knowable only after a generation, voice or render (`probe`: the cheapest earlier probe), D external or transient (`resume`), I an engine invariant no plan can break (`guard`), N not a refusal (`why`). `was`: B means the hole was closed by E106. A new later-stage code fails migration/ops/test_refusal_parity.py until it is classified here.
